reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating agent tool execution through a model-based review gate for selected dangerous actions, with additional external model routing and usage billing features.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的部分高风险工具调用增加模型审查、拒绝或升级流程，并提供外部模型路由与按请求计费功能。
summaries.en: This plugin adds model-based review, denial, or escalation for selected high-risk tool calls in DeepSeek Harness agents, along with external model routing and per-request billing.

capabilities: Intercepts selected potentially dangerous agent tool calls before execution
Sends flagged calls to an external reviewer model for allow, deny, or escalation decisions
Can deny or defer tool execution based on review results
Provides an external model-provider route with per-request USDC payment over x402
Reports spending by model and request usage
